name: ThrowDisposed
corrections_note: DisposeHelper is a property of ResiliencePipeline (the helper instance), not a method.

name: EnsureNotDisposed
corrections_note: CircuitBreakerManualControl.CloseAsync/IsolateAsync/Initialize invoke the callbacks CircuitBreakerResilienceStrategy registers (_controller.IsolateCircuitAsync, _controller.CloseCircuitAsync); the truth's `delegates` record who registers a method group, not who invokes the delegate field, so these are neither right nor wrong by hand.

name: GetTableMapping
corrections_note: ModificationCommandComparer and UpdateSqlGenerator are type names a property shares, not methods. SqlServerModificationCommandBatch.IsValid reads ColumnModifications through IReadOnlyModificationCommand (reached via dispatch) but is in EFCore.SqlServer, which the cs-truth job does not compile.
